agent_explanation: Fast grazing contact on thin wall (h=0.2): body falls onto wall top at high horizontal speed (~46.6 m/s) and sinks progressively (clearance +0.007 at step 39, penetration -0.072 at step 40, -0.152 at step 41) with vy staying ~-20 m/s, i.e. no bounce impulse/positional correction separates it. Likely discrete collision handling fails for high-tangential-velocity resting contact on a thin box, letting normal penetration accumulate past tolerance.
